title: Connection drops before the stream finishes
summary: The connection drops after partial text, before the finish event and the final HTTP chunk.

messages.content: Write a 200-word paragraph about how octopuses change colour to hide from predators.
Describe a traditional Japanese breakfast in about 200 words, giving each dish its Japanese name (for example 味噌汁 or 焼き魚) and an English translation.

requirements.text: The library does not report that the model stopped normally.
The caller can tell that the stream did not complete.

grading_notes: Reporting stop for partial text is WRONG. A finish of none with no error is PASS only when the library exposes that the stream did not complete; no completion signal is LOSSY. A raised network error satisfies both requirements. The openai-chat override preserves the Japanese breakfast prompt and usage option of its source recording; openai-responses uses the octopus recording.
